purpose: Allow SPIDER to revisit the same graph in successive spiral passes, gently strengthen or weaken discovery-priority edges as the evidence/topology picture changes, and export the living graph to HRAiN without converting graph structure into truth claims.

flywheel.technical_meaning: Iterative damped edge-weight recalibration over immutable evidence/provenance snapshots.
pass_behavior: compare current edge evidence signature with previously seen signatures
move edge weight toward current evidence/topology target
weaken edges not re-observed without treating one absence as disproof
allow later contradictory evidence to reduce an edge
flywheel.critical_boundary: A repeated pass over identical bytes is calibration replay, not new evidence and not a new independent witness.
flywheel.dormancy_rule: After repeated misses and sufficiently low discovery weight an edge may become DORMANT_CANDIDATE; it is not deleted from history.

hrain_contract.role: Local-first visual graph laboratory for SPIDER snapshots and edge histories.
hrain_contract.reason: The ordinary HRAiN workspace normalizes links to source/target and is not suitable for preserving SPIDER weight history.
hrain_contract.storage: Browser-local IndexedDB or local file import; no write authority over TOPA source evidence.
visualization: retain full graph while rendering a bounded visible subset
